summary: Completed frontend-only regression testing for final branding, skin-card refresh, native drag prevention, black-band repro flow, responsive behavior, unit tests, and production build on external preview URL.

issues: Automated mouse-wheel check did not produce vertical scroll delta in emulated mobile viewport; touch-scroll remained not conclusively verifiable via this automation path and should be validated on real touch input.

action_items: Optional: manually verify mobile touch scrolling on a physical device/browser touch emulation because automated wheel events are not a reliable touch proxy.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Reused existing auth test user discord_it1_rapid_100hz from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Branding/meta checks passed (IMG icons, SPAN wordmarks, Rubik font, exact meta text, absolute OG/Twitter image URLs, favicon/apple icon endpoints return image content-types). Skin cards: rarity-dot absent; click and keyboard toggles work; editable price/search inputs still allow text selection. Native drag regression probe in real browser gestures (shop+inventory, >10s) reported dragstartTrusted=0, pointercancelTrusted=0, selection text empty, and normal clicks kept working post-gesture without force/Escape/reload. Black-band repro flow executed at 1920x800 with zoom 1.5 and wheel sequence (+25,+35,-50) plus rapid target switching over ~6s; source/target/gauge backdropFilter computed as none and no moving horizontal rectangle was observed in captured phases.
rca of the issue: Previous native drag lockout root cause appears mitigated by user-select:none on game interaction surfaces plus dragstart preventDefault handler outside editable fields. Black-band regression likely tied to GPU/compositor backdrop re-sampling from runtime blur; current build has backdrop filters removed on source/target previews and gauge disc, matching expected mitigation. Exact user GPU artifact could not be reproduced in this environment during scripted scroll/zoom cycles.
